description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2530219064043 HOUSING,THRUST PIEC: Line 0001 Qty 228 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0068 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 34. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 56161 10501119; 7A8G4 972530009; S3002 2403-8224.00. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
